The AI's measured bounding box exactly matches the static ground truth, indicating its mesh analysis is accurate. The AI's slicing analysis reveals the inverse: the base slice has a max radius of 50mm (0mm protrusion from the 50mm hub radius), while the top slice has a max radius of 28.5mm (~13.5mm protrusion from the 15mm hub radius).
